text: What if nobody on Earth needed sleep anymore? Starting tonight.
Eleven p m. You're not tired. Two a m. Still not tired. You finish a whole series before sunrise.
The gym is packed at four in the morning. Supermarkets stay open. Your city never turns the lights off.
Your boss sends a new schedule. Sixteen hour shifts, because why not. Half the office quits by Friday.
You learn guitar, a new language, and how to cook. At three a m, everyone is online. The group chat never stops.
Nobody dreams anymore. You didn't think you'd miss it. You miss it.
Scientists find a pill that brings sleep back. Eight hours, once a week. The line outside the pharmacy is four kilometers long.
What would you do with eight extra hours? Tell me in the comments.
